technology.summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is focused on how to build an enduring company in the AI era. Microsoft has announced its third-generation Maia in-house AI chip, which will make it less reliant on Nvidia's GPUs. Amazon has over 1 million robot workers, which raises questions about the future of human employees. Fitbit has released the Fitbit Edge, a fitness tracker for those who don't want to go totally screenless.

finance.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has partnered with the Reserve Bank of India to improve regulatory procedures, particularly for foreign portfolio investors. The Nifty 50 index closed down by 95.75 points, reaching 22,620.45, due to profit booking and rising oil prices. A resurgent El Niño pattern could deepen a selloff in Southeast Asian bonds, pushing yields higher as US Treasury rates and oil prices rise. Market experts have shared their top stock picks for 1 October.

politics.summary:
The Delhi High Court has dismissed pleas for a SIT probe into the 2020 riots and 2019 Jamia violence. Meanwhile, the Supreme Court will list a plea to allow peaceful protests at Jantar Mantar, where protesters are demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

In other news, Donald Trump has cited a non-existent Indian election to call the US electoral process 'corrupt'. Jairam Ramesh has attacked the CEC, claiming his ability to execute illegal orders makes him a liability for the country.

India's foreign exchange reserves have reportedly declined by USD 18.34 billion in a single week, and Bengali actor Koel Mallick has joined the BJP.
